'''Virtual card icons''' are shorthand symbols in the game text of [[Players Committee]] Virtual Set slips (Virtual Original era), explained in an ICON KEY on each set's PDF.

Related: [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]], [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]], [[V-slips]].

== Icon key (VirtualCards1.pdf &mdash; Legacy sheet, Dec 2006) ==

The [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006) prints this ICON KEY.<ref name="vc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153847/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards1.pdf VirtualCards1.pdf], swccgpc.com Resources (Wayback, 24 October 2007)</ref>

[[File:VS1-Legacy-icon-key.png|640px]]

{| class="wikitable"
! Icon !! Meaning (as printed on the Legacy ICON KEY)
|-
|| [[File:VS-icon-immune-alter.png|40px]] || (Immune to Alter.)
|-
|| [[File:VS-icon-immune-control.png|40px]] || (Immune to Control.)
|-
|| [[File:VS-icon-immune-sense.png|40px]] || (Immune to Sense.)
|-
|| [[File:VS-icon-pilot-power-x.png|40px]] X || X (Replaced the phrase "Adds X to power of anything he/she pilots" in the game text.)
|-

|| [[File:VS-icon-grabber.png|40px]] || This icon indicates the card is a 'grabber'.

|-
|| black downward triangle || Replaced the phrase- "Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle."

== Same ICON KEY family on DefensiveShields.pdf (Defensive Shields) ==

The [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]] sheet (Virtual Set: Defensive Shields, official text as of 4 December 2006) prints the same ICON KEY wording as the Legacy sheet.<ref name="ds">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071028141121/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/DefensiveShields.pdf DefensiveShields.pdf], swccgpc.com Resources (Wayback, 28 October 2007)</ref> It covers Alter, Control and Sense immunity, pilot power X, maintenance, grabber and the triangles.

[[File:PS1-DefensiveShields-icon-key.png|640px]]

== Earlier Premium Edition ICON KEY (VirtualCards1Premium.pdf) ==

The Premium Edition sheet covers the same twelve VS1 cards as the Legacy sheet, with its own ICON KEY.<ref name="vc1p">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1Premium.pdf VirtualCards1Premium.pdf], Virtual Set #1 Premium Edition, res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020214519/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1Premium.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The early VirtualCards1a slips sheet (March 2002) has no ICON KEY block.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193759/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

[[File:VS1-Premium-icon-key.png|640px]]

The Premium ICON KEY prints:

* A (Immune to Alter.)
* C (Immune to Control.)
* S (Immune to Sense.)
* P X (Replaced the phrase "Adds X to power of anything he/she pilots" in the game text, unless otherwise specified, and is considered to have a Pilot icon.)
* Upward triangle: Replaced the phrase- "Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle."
* Downward triangle: Replaced the phrase- "Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle."

The Legacy ICON KEY adds lines for the maintenance-cost icon and the grabber icon.<ref name="vc1" />

== Modern Virtual icon reference (February 2024) ==

The Players Committee's [[Media:Icon_Reference_Sheet_Feb_2024.pdf|Icon Reference Sheet (February 2024)]] is the game aid for current Virtual card icons.
